finding.summary: When os.getenv("NNSMITH_G_CONFIG", "1") != "1": The environment variable NNSMITH_G_CONFIG selects which parameter-guidance table GuidedGen uses: "0" = PARAM_CONFIG0 (no parameter guidance at all, only input-shape guidance), "1" = PARAM_CONFIG1, "2" = PARAM_CONFIG2 (pads get symmetric bins). This changes the constraints added in `extra_constraints`/`post_process`, i.e. which models are generated...
